primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model - **Big phase:** binary-lifting on under-provisioned jobs — decouple tuning from the DAG by first allocating enough parallelism to clear backpressure (handles the shifting-bottleneck problem), decomposing the job into N concurrently-tunable sub-problems.
primitives.assumptions: PA(p) relationship is invariant; sufficient parallelism clears backpressure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When initial allocation fails to resolve backpressure, reconfiguration becomes necessary.

primitives.name: Gaussian Process Posterior Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations & assumptions - GP posterior: μ(p_i) = k_*^T K^-1 y; σ2(p_i) = k_*(p_i,p_i) - k_*^T K^-1 k_*; confidence bounds l(p_i) = μ - βσ, u(p_i) = μ + βσ.
primitives.latex: \mu(p_i) = k_*^T K^{-1} y, \quad \sigma^2(p_i) = k_*(p_i,p_i) - k_*^T K^{-1} k_*, \quad l(p_i) = \mu - \beta\sigma, \quad u(p_i) = \mu + \beta\sigma
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'k_*': 'kernel vector (dimensionless)', 'K': 'kernel matrix (dimensionless)', 'y': 'observed performance values (dimensionless)', 'β': 'confidence parameter (dimensionless)', 'l(p_i)': 'lower confidence bound (dimensionless)', 'u(p_i)': 'upper confidence bound (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Kernel function is stationary; noise is additive and positive; GP prior is valid.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When kernel matrix becomes ill-conditioned or noise exceeds variance.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in combining binary lifting with a conservative Bayesian acquisition function that avoids aggressive exploration. In GSE, this translates to a two-phase strategy: first, ensure sufficient parallelism to eliminate bottlenecks (Big phase), then optimize within a safe region using Gaussian processes (CBO). The key insight is that SLA violations arise from over-exploration, so the acquisition function must be gated by feasibility constraints. The O(1) complexity emerges from amortizing reconfiguration costs across tuning iterations, assuming stable performance relationships. The trade-off gate ensures conservative behavior when uncertainty is high, preventing costly missteps. This framework directly maps to GSE's need for robust, scalable tuning of compute-intensive batch jobs under SLA constraints.
